## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

[About Us][10] [Our Services][11]

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

Protecting IP with a wealth of experience.

Moeller IP Advisors offers a complete range of Intellectual Property and Regulatory Affairs
services. With four local offices strategically located in Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, and Mexico,
we have over 90 experts ready to protect your IP assets in all emerging markets. We simplify the
process by providing a single point of contact and one power of attorney for IP management
worldwide. 

We make IP easy to navigate.

## Our Key Advantages

### **A Single Point of Contact**

From our local offices in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina and Uruguay we act as a one-stop solution for
Latin America & Emerging Market Economies.

### **Valuable experience**

With almost a century of experience, we are ideally qualified to tackle IP in Latin America &
Emerging Market Economies. What we’ve learned from the past enables us to reap benefits for the
future.

### **Latin America & Emerging markets expertise**

Our team possesses deep knowledge in navigating the complexities of emerging markets, allowing us to
provide tailored solutions for protecting intellectual property in these rapidly evolving
environments.

## Our IP Legal Services

We offer the complete range of Intellectual Property and Regulatory Affairs services. Over 90
technical and legal experts are ready to assist you with only one power of attorney (anywhere in the
world). We make things easy in regions that are challenging.

### Legal

From IP and Patent Enforcement to Patent Term Extension, Plant Variety, Data Protection and Privacy,
and Regulatory Affairs, we offer a one-stop shop for all your legal needs.

[Read more][40]

### Patents, Utility Models and Industrial Designs

Our highly experienced teams of lawyers and technical professionals performs drafting of patents,
patentability searches, filing andprosecution of Patents, Industrial Desings and Utility Models and
Assignment of rights, among others.

[Read more][41]

### Anti Counterfeiting

We protect your brand not only with traditional AC and enforcement operations, but also with
innovative solutions such as Online Monitoring, Supply Chain Intelligence, Broder Protection,
Domain. Name Watching & Recovery and Training Seminars.

[Read more][42]

### Trademarks

We provide end-to-end protection to brands and copyright. From conducting Clearance and Availability
Searches to handling the Filing and Prosecution of Trademarks, Copyrights, we are there every step
of the way. To ensure ongoing protection, we resolve conflicts and provide Trademark Watching
services.

[Read more][43]

We receive the sworn translation request and find a sworn translator in the respective language pair

statement is checked. If the sworn translation needs to be legalized, we can handle it too.

Intellectual property rights are legal protections for creations of the mind, including artistic,
literary, and musical works, designs, inventions, and business assets, like brand names and logos.
Common forms of intellectual property legal protections include trademarks, copyright, and patents.
An intellectual property lawyer helps individuals and businesses to properly register, protect and
manage their IP through a variety of non-contentious (e.g. registering a right) and contentious

commercial value of their work.

Identifying intellectual property rights should be a focus for all businesses, whether you are an
entrepreneur, start-up, SME or international organisation. IP is not just for technology start-ups.

way towards giving you a competitive advantage and strong brand which you can monetise. Some IP
rights arise automatically but others (and stronger, more easily enforceable forms of protection)
need to be registered at the appropriate registry.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community

* Directors of Organizations

* Drug Delivery Entities

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# Q-ID® from Quantum Base: a new global standard in anti-counterfeit product security
* **Secure** – Quantum secure Q-ID® cannot be practically copied, cloned or faked.
* **Unique** – Every Q-ID® is a unique digital identity, due to atomic level imperfections.
* **Smartphone authentication** – Quickly and easily authenticate Q-ID® with any smartphone.
* **Simple integration** – With all common printing methods and substrates.
* **Global Data** – Capture product, location, and consumer engagement data for brand new insights.

[Find Out More][62]

Over 1.5 billion Q-ID®s now produced

## Stops counterfeits. Simple smartphone authentication. Scalable. Proven.

The Q-ID®’s atomic-level security **stops counterfeits** and prevents fraud, signalling a major step
change in product authentication and brand protection.

Quantum Base has set a new global standard in anti-counterfeiting security with Q-ID® - a
quantum-unique fingerprint, which can be applied to all global products, cannot be practically
copied, and is digitally authenticated in seconds with a standard **smartphone**.

With over 7bn smartphones on the planet, Q-ID® transforms each and every one into a vital weapon in
the fight against counterfeit products.

Annually, over 1m deaths are caused by counterfeit drugs, with counterfeiting now a $2.8tn global
problem.

[Phone scanning Q-ID®]

Q-ID® stops this with a truly **scalable**, quantum-secure solution – **simple integration** with

# RFID Technology Is Changing the Way We Connect with People, Places and Things

[ Contact an RFID Expert ][27]

## RFID Is Identity Technology

RFID is more than just a modern answer to barcodes and UIDs — it’s a transformative technology
reshaping how we understand systems, processes, the built environment and business itself. **But**
**true RFID innovation starts with knowledge**.

**That’s why we created RFID.com** — **your ultimate resource for everything RFID, from the
fundamentals to advanced applications.** Whether you’re looking to streamline operations, enhance
security, optimize inventory management or explore cutting-edge use cases, RFID is revolutionizing
industries in ways many have yet to realize.

RFID.com is your gateway to understanding this technology, unlocking its limitless potential and
finding the right solutions to get started.

##### Discover. Build. Transform.

#### Choose Your Industry
* Medical Devices
* Consumables
* Rental Assets & Returnable Transport Items
* Manufacturing & Automotive
* Logistics & Supply Chain
* Energy, Utilities & Waste
* Agriculture & Animal ID
* Oil & Gas/Hazmat
* Construction
* Hospitality
* Commercial Laundry & Uniform

#### Medical Devices

Today’s medical device original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) face a myriad of challenges, risks
and market pressures. When RFID is embedded into medical devices, supplies and consumables, the
unique capabilities of this technology help OEMs address and mitigate these wide-ranging concerns in
a number of ways.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What does RFID MFG manufacture?

We are a direct RFID and smart-card manufacturer producing [RFID & NFC cards][35], [key fobs][36],
[wristbands][37], [labels & inlays][38], [RFID tags][39], [RFID-blocking products][40] and
[readers/IoT hardware][41] — all customizable to your chip, size, artwork and encoding.

Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?

A manufacturer. RFID MFG has produced RFID and smart-card products since 1996 from a self-built,
ISO-certified 20,000 m² factory in Shenzhen, exporting to 100+ countries. Buying direct means
factory pricing and full control over customization and quality.

What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

MOQ is flexible and depends on the product — often from a few hundred pieces for cards, wristbands
and key fobs, and from around a thousand for labels and inlays. Share your target quantity for an
exact wholesale quote.

Can I get a free sample before ordering?

Yes. Free pre-production samples are available so you can verify material, print and chip
performance before committing to a full run.

Do you offer custom OEM / ODM and chip encoding?

Yes — full OEM/ODM with in-house R&D: custom chip, frequency, size, material, artwork, packaging and
pre-encoding, with custom keys under NDA.

How long does production take?

Typically 3–7 days for samples and 7–18 days for bulk production after artwork and encoding are
approved, then worldwide shipping. We reply to quotes within 24 hours.

planet.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What does RFID MFG manufacture?

We are a direct RFID and smart-card manufacturer producing [RFID & NFC cards][35], [key fobs][36],
[wristbands][37], [labels & inlays][38], [RFID tags][39], [RFID-blocking products][40] and
[readers/IoT hardware][41] — all customizable to your chip, size, artwork and encoding.

Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?

A manufacturer. RFID MFG has produced RFID and smart-card products since 1996 from a self-built,
ISO-certified 20,000 m² factory in Shenzhen, exporting to 100+ countries. Buying direct means
factory pricing and full control over customization and quality.

What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

MOQ is flexible and depends on the product — often from a few hundred pieces for cards, wristbands
and key fobs, and from around a thousand for labels and inlays. Share your target quantity for an
exact wholesale quote.

Can I get a free sample before ordering?

Yes. Free pre-production samples are available so you can verify material, print and chip
performance before committing to a full run.

Do you offer custom OEM / ODM and chip encoding?

Yes — full OEM/ODM with in-house R&D: custom chip, frequency, size, material, artwork, packaging and
pre-encoding, with custom keys under NDA.

How long does production take?

Typically 3–7 days for samples and 7–18 days for bulk production after artwork and encoding are
approved, then worldwide shipping. We reply to quotes within 24 hours.

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren

der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

[Rendering einer bottelpack Anlage bp550]

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

[BFS entdecken][42]
[bottelpack Anlagen entdecken][43]

cdmo

## BFS-Lohnabfüllung und Entwicklung

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

Medical-grade skincare contains high-strength active ingredients backed by clinical research.
Designed to treat specific skin concerns, medical-grade products penetrate deeper than standard
skincare and are typically recommended by professionals for optimal results.

Medical-grade skincare offers higher-strength ingredients and deeper results, making it more
effective for treating specific concerns than most over-the-counter products.

# Track & Trace

## Easy Parcel Manager & Tracker

Parcel manager for all your purchases. Control parcels from different postal and logistics couriers
in one place. The easy parcel tracking solution for online shoppers and small businesses.

## [Track & Trace Any Parcels Worldwide][11]

Enter Tracking Number
Track

To track shipment, enter your tracking number in the search field above and click "Track".

# The Track & Trace Advantages

Track & Trace helps to track and manage international parcels from postal logistics services.

# Universal Parcel Management and Postal Tracking

**Track & Trace **is a universal [package tracking][50] and [management platform][51] designed for
individuals and e-commerce projects. Our goal is to help you organize, track, and understand the
journey of your parcels from hundreds of **global postal services** and **courier companies** in one
place.

## Understanding International Postal Systems

Every country operates its own postal service, connected through the [Universal Postal Union
(UPU)][52]. This global network unites **over 190 national operators** and sets standards for mail
exchange, **tracking numbers**, and delivery procedures. Thanks to this cooperation, your package
from one country can be delivered smoothly to another, regardless of the carrier involved.

Modern **information systems** and **management tools** enable **postal operators** to share
tracking data in real-time, and **the Track & Trace Service** makes this data accessible to you
through a single interface.

## How the Track & Trace Works

Enter your **tracking number** in the search field above to get live updates from official postal
systems. Whether it's a [USPS][53] shipment, a [Canada Post][54] package, or a [China Post][55]
package, our system automatically detects the carrier and retrieves accurate status information.

If you regularly handle multiple shipments, our [Parcel Manager][56] is here to empower you. It's a
simple yet powerful productivity tool that keeps all your deliveries organized, tracks progress,
marks parcels as favorites, sorts them, and moves old parcels to the archive. With this tool, you're
in control of your shipments, every step of the way.

## The Role of the UPU (Universal Postal Union)

The **Universal Postal Union** serves as the foundation of the **international postal network**. The
UPU fosters collaboration among postal operators, establishes essential standards for mail exchange,
and ensures seamless global interoperability of postal and logistics systems. By unifying delivery
standards, data exchange protocols, and customs forms, and by enhancing the [Express Mail Service
(EMS)][57], the UPU truly exemplifies our commitment to providing reliable and efficient service
worldwide.

One of the UPU's standards is the [S10 tracking format][58], which enables postal systems to
identify and trace items using a consistent numbering structure. Our [tracking number validator][59]
confidently verifies your tracking number or order, helping you easily confirm authenticity and
avoid invalid numbers.

## Global Postal Network and Delivery Internationally

When you send a parcel internationally, it goes through a complex but standardized process
involving:
1. Acceptance by the origin post office;
2. Export and international transport;
3. Customs clearance and sorting in the destination country;
4. Finally, delivery by the domestic carrier.

Each step in a package's journey generates a new tracking event. [Understanding these statuses][60]
will help you determine where your package is and what stage it's at in its journey to you.

## Common Tracking Issues and Best Practices

Delays, customs clearance, or lost parcels can happen to anyone - even when everything seems normal.
Our [Tracking Section][61] offers practical guides and explanations to help you handle the most
common delivery problems, for example:
1. **The order shows as delivered, but I haven't received it.** - Learn why this happens and what
   steps to take to locate your package;
2. **Customs is holding the packages. -** Understand customs processing times, required
   documentation, and how to avoid long delays;
3. **The tracking events have not been updated for several days.** - Find out what causes tracking
   gaps and when it's time to contact the carrier;
4. **The shipment was damaged or lost.** - See how to file a claim and what evidence you need to
   support it;
5. **The courier attempted delivery, but you weren't home.** - Learn how to reschedule or pick up
   your package at your local post office.

## Worldwide Postal Operators

Looking for a **delivery service to the US** or your **local postal carrier**? Browse our [directory
of postal carriers][62], which includes UPU members and the world's largest logistics companies.
Each section provides information about the courier, including links to **the official website**,
**support phone number**, **email address**, **tracking tools**, and an **IMPC** (International Mail
Processing Centers) list to determine the parcel's location.

**The Track & Trace Management Tool** combines technology and transparency, helping you stay in
control of every shipment, wherever it travels.

# Frequently Asked Questions

We've compiled answers to some common queries to help you better understand the Track & Trace
Productivity Tool:
* ## What Makes the TrackTrace.Delivery Different?
  
  Unlike single-carrier trackers, we collect and synchronize tracking data from hundreds of official
  postal services and courier APIs, providing a unified, transparent way to track all your parcels
  worldwide.
  
  The **TrackTrace.Delivery** is not just a tracker - it's a complete parcel management platform.
  Here's what sets it apart:
  * **Package Managing**:  Manage all your purchases in one place. Add, note, sort, and archive
    shipments for improved organization.
  * **Couriers Detection**: Enter a tracking number to identify the courier handling your parcel
    automatically.
  * **Parcels Sync**: Sign in to synchronize your parcel list across all your devices.
  * **Couriers Catalog**: Obtain contact details and information about national postal services and
    logistics couriers for efficient communication.
  
  Together, these features make **Track and Trace** more than an **online tool** - it's your
  personal logistics assistant. In short, it's purpose-built productivity software for parcel
  workflows - not just a viewer of tracking pages.
* ## Can I Manage and Track Multiple Parcels?
  
  Yes! [Parcel Manager][63] lets you store parcels by tracking number, label them, and receive
  updates - the perfect solution for small online stores and active online shoppers. Real-time
  information on your parcel's current status and progress will keep you informed of any changes.
  This multi-functional solution is ideal for those who send and receive parcels through **multiple
  postal services** and want to **optimize parcel management**.
* ## How Do I Know if my Postal Tracking Number is Valid?
  
  We have a solution! Use our [tracking number validator][64] to ensure your number complies with
  the UPU S10 standard. This online tool lets you verify that an official postal service issues your
  number. Once you verify it, you can easily add the number to the [Parcels Section][65] for quick
  access.
* ## Where Can I Learn More About Parcel Statuses?
  
  Check out the [Package Tracking][66] section for a complete overview of tracking statuses. Here
  you'll find detailed explanations of various tracking statuses, including **Pick Up**, **In
  Transit**, or **Delivered**. This section also addresses common issues, such as delays, and
  provides clear troubleshooting instructions if your package's status isn't updating, and offers
  many more solutions in FAQ form.
* ## Which Couriers are Supported?
  
  We offer an extensive carrier directory covering a wide range of delivery services worldwide. This
  directory includes not only major carriers such as **USPS**, **Canada Post**, **China Post**,
  **Deutsche Post**, **Australia Post**, but also many other international and domestic carriers.
  
  For added convenience, **Track & Trace** provides quick access to customer support for each
  carrier. This feature allows users to quickly contact their chosen carrier directly for assistance
  with package issues, delivery, or any other questions.

from one country can be delivered smoothly to another, regardless of the carrier involved.

Modern **information systems** and **management tools** enable **postal operators** to share
tracking data in real-time, and **the Track & Trace Service** makes this data accessible to you
through a single interface.

## How the Track & Trace Works

Enter your **tracking number** in the search field above to get live updates from official postal
systems. Whether it's a [USPS][53] shipment, a [Canada Post][54] package, or a [China Post][55]
package, our system automatically detects the carrier and retrieves accurate status information.

If you regularly handle multiple shipments, our [Parcel Manager][56] is here to empower you. It's a
simple yet powerful productivity tool that keeps all your deliveries organized, tracks progress,
marks parcels as favorites, sorts them, and moves old parcels to the archive. With this tool, you're
in control of your shipments, every step of the way.

## The Role of the UPU (Universal Postal Union)

The **Universal Postal Union** serves as the foundation of the **international postal network**. The
UPU fosters collaboration among postal operators, establishes essential standards for mail exchange,
and ensures seamless global interoperability of postal and logistics systems. By unifying delivery
standards, data exchange protocols, and customs forms, and by enhancing the [Express Mail Service
(EMS)][57], the UPU truly exemplifies our commitment to providing reliable and efficient service
worldwide.

One of the UPU's standards is the [S10 tracking format][58], which enables postal systems to
identify and trace items using a consistent numbering structure. Our [tracking number validator][59]
confidently verifies your tracking number or order, helping you easily confirm authenticity and
avoid invalid numbers.

## Global Postal Network and Delivery Internationally

When you send a parcel internationally, it goes through a complex but standardized process
involving:
1. Acceptance by the origin post office;
2. Export and international transport;
3. Customs clearance and sorting in the destination country;
4. Finally, delivery by the domestic carrier.

Each step in a package's journey generates a new tracking event. [Understanding these statuses][60]
will help you determine where your package is and what stage it's at in its journey to you.

## Common Tracking Issues and Best Practices

Delays, customs clearance, or lost parcels can happen to anyone - even when everything seems normal.
Our [Tracking Section][61] offers practical guides and explanations to help you handle the most
common delivery problems, for example:
1. **The order shows as delivered, but I haven't received it.** - Learn why this happens and what
   steps to take to locate your package;
2. **Customs is holding the packages. -** Understand customs processing times, required
   documentation, and how to avoid long delays;
3. **The tracking events have not been updated for several days.** - Find out what causes tracking
   gaps and when it's time to contact the carrier;
4. **The shipment was damaged or lost.** - See how to file a claim and what evidence you need to
   support it;
5. **The courier attempted delivery, but you weren't home.** - Learn how to reschedule or pick up
   your package at your local post office.

## Worldwide Postal Operators

Looking for a **delivery service to the US** or your **local postal carrier**? Browse our [directory
of postal carriers][62], which includes UPU members and the world's largest logistics companies.
Each section provides information about the courier, including links to **the official website**,
**support phone number**, **email address**, **tracking tools**, and an **IMPC** (International Mail
Processing Centers) list to determine the parcel's location.

**The Track & Trace Management Tool** combines technology and transparency, helping you stay in
control of every shipment, wherever it travels.

# Frequently Asked Questions

We've compiled answers to some common queries to help you better understand the Track & Trace
Productivity Tool:
* ## What Makes the TrackTrace.Delivery Different?
  
  Unlike single-carrier trackers, we collect and synchronize tracking data from hundreds of official
  postal services and courier APIs, providing a unified, transparent way to track all your parcels
  worldwide.
  
  The **TrackTrace.Delivery** is not just a tracker - it's a complete parcel management platform.
  Here's what sets it apart:
  * **Package Managing**:  Manage all your purchases in one place. Add, note, sort, and archive
    shipments for improved organization.
  * **Couriers Detection**: Enter a tracking number to identify the courier handling your parcel
    automatically.
  * **Parcels Sync**: Sign in to synchronize your parcel list across all your devices.
  * **Couriers Catalog**: Obtain contact details and information about national postal services and
    logistics couriers for efficient communication.
  
  Together, these features make **Track and Trace** more than an **online tool** - it's your
  personal logistics assistant. In short, it's purpose-built productivity software for parcel
  workflows - not just a viewer of tracking pages.
* ## Can I Manage and Track Multiple Parcels?
  
  Yes! [Parcel Manager][63] lets you store parcels by tracking number, label them, and receive
  updates - the perfect solution for small online stores and active online shoppers. Real-time
  information on your parcel's current status and progress will keep you informed of any changes.
  This multi-functional solution is ideal for those who send and receive parcels through **multiple
  postal services** and want to **optimize parcel management**.
* ## How Do I Know if my Postal Tracking Number is Valid?
  
  We have a solution! Use our [tracking number validator][64] to ensure your number complies with
  the UPU S10 standard. This online tool lets you verify that an official postal service issues your
  number. Once you verify it, you can easily add the number to the [Parcels Section][65] for quick
  access.
* ## Where Can I Learn More About Parcel Statuses?
  
  Check out the [Package Tracking][66] section for a complete overview of tracking statuses. Here
  you'll find detailed explanations of various tracking statuses, including **Pick Up**, **In
  Transit**, or **Delivered**. This section also addresses common issues, such as delays, and
  provides clear troubleshooting instructions if your package's status isn't updating, and offers
  many more solutions in FAQ form.
* ## Which Couriers are Supported?
  
  We offer an extensive carrier directory covering a wide range of delivery services worldwide. This
  directory includes not only major carriers such as **USPS**, **Canada Post**, **China Post**,
  **Deutsche Post**, **Australia Post**, but also many other international and domestic carriers.
  
  For added convenience, **Track & Trace** provides quick access to customer support for each
  carrier. This feature allows users to quickly contact their chosen carrier directly for assistance
  with package issues, delivery, or any other questions.

and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.

  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created

  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.

  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
